results.summary: Designed JWT-based authentication system with refresh tokens
results.design: RESTful endpoints: POST /auth/login, POST /auth/refresh, POST /auth/logout. JWT tokens with 15min expiry. Refresh tokens stored in database with 7-day expiry. Bcrypt for password hashing.
recommendations: Implement rate limiting on login endpoint
Add email verification before allowing login
Consider adding OAuth2 support for social login
